listenings.text: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. This is an announcement for all passengers on the eight o'clock flight. We are very sorry, but your flight is delayed. The new time is ten fifteen, so that is two hours and fifteen minutes from now. The reason is the weather, not the aircraft. Please stay near the gate, because if the weather is better, the flight is earlier, and this is the place for the next announcement. There is coffee and there is water in the room behind you, and it is free tonight for all passengers on this flight. If you have a connection after this flight, please come to the desk now. Thank you for your patience.

Hey, it's me. I am still at the airport, two more hours, so there is time to talk. Listen, this is funny. There is a woman next to me, and normally I am quiet with people, you know me. But tonight I have one question for her. Only one: where are you from? And the answer is twenty minutes long. Twenty. She is from Ireland, her work is with horses, and her next stop is Argentina, three months on a farm. Is her English clear for me? Maybe half, honestly, but that is not a problem, because my reactions are at the right moments: really, interesting, and two more questions. Two hours, and I am not bored, and my phone is in my pocket. Anyway. Call me when you land.

extra_audio.text: Excuse me, is this seat free? Where are you from? Really? That is interesting. And what do you do there? Sorry, can you repeat that, please?
